integrity: Self-contained direct proof; norm equalities use finite-support witnesses for each integer n. No external software certificate is needed.
scientific_limitations: Specific ℓ2-negative/ℓp-positive extension only. Does not rule out other unitary extensions. The proof uses sharp finite-dimensional norm embeddings. Potential older general mixed-norm shift coverage not fully ruled out. Independent mathematical audit not performed.
title: Sharp two-sided power growth for the mixed \(\ell_2\)–\(\ell_p\) Wold extension
